window-1.title: Infinite Craft
window-1.blurb: You start with Water, Fire, Wind and Earth and somehow end up inventing 'Betty Boop Dragon Sushi' at 2am — it's a pure creative rabbit hole with no rules, exactly your kind of side quest.

window-2.title: Type of Culture — Keya Vadgama
window-2.blurb: A one-woman newsletter that reads type as pop culture rather than portfolio polish — basically a smart friend explaining why that bubble-font shop sign is doing more than it lets on.

window-3.title: Summertime Aguas Frescas
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients and a blender gets you an endlessly remixable fruit-and-lime cooler — cucumber-mint one day, pineapple the next — perfect for Singapore heat and for dressing up in your prettiest glass.

window-4.title: Before & After: A Colorful, Modern Update for a Late 19th-Century Apartment
window-4.blurb: The trick here is painting the trim — window frames, door frames, skirting boards — in colour instead of default white, which turns an old room into something hand-drawn and lived-in, exactly the kind of low-cost, high-commitment side quest you'd finish in a weekend.

window-5.title: Pout Rooftop Cafe, South Bridge Road
window-5.blurb: A secret sixth-floor rooftop you'd never spot from the street, with pastries, a skyline that doesn't look like Singapore, and exactly the kind of golden-hour light your film camera has been waiting for.
